title: GeneratedMCPServerPackage
description: Contract for a generated package's top-level manifest (generate's output). References tools.json (mcp-tool-definition.schema.json, array) and oauthConfig (oauth-config.schema.json) rather than inlining them.

targetLanguage.description: Selected per FR-018. Determines which peer runtime package `serve`/`validate` dispatch to.

runtimeVersion.description: Pinned version of the selected language's runtime library, recorded for Constitution Principle VII traceability.

deploymentModes.description: MUST always contain both values — deployment mode is a serve-time choice, not a generate-time fork (FR-015).

runtimePolicy.description: MUST be identical across targetLanguage values (Constitution Principle VI).
